crossRefs.note: To the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its…
Dimnah with its pasture lands, and Nahalal with its pasture lands: four cities.
Zebulun didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites lived among…
When Jabin king of Hazor heard of it, he sent to Jobab king of Madon, to the king of Shimron, to the king of Achshaph,
the king of Shimron Meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;
So they both went until they came to Bethlehem. When they had come to Bethlehem, all the city was excited about them…
David longed, and said, “Oh that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”

people.name: Bethlehem

people.name: Kitron
people.line: A city in Zebulun not conquered

people.name: Shimron
people.line: Canaanite city conquered by Joshua, allotted to Zebulun

translations.web: Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.
translations.bsb: It also included Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem. There were twelve cities, along with their villages.
translations.kjv: And Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.
